prompt_text: Who is the best roofer in Denver for hail damage repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” roofer for hail repair — the right company depends on your exact location in Denver, the scope of damage, whether you’re filing an insurance claim, and your priorities (speed, price, warranty, materials). I can find and compare top-rated local roofers if you tell me your ZIP code. Meanwhile, here’s a quick guide so you can pick a trustworthy hail‑damage roofer:

What to look for
- Local experience with hail claims and Denver codes/permits.
- Proper insurance: general liability and workers’ comp. Ask to see certificates.
- Manufacturer certifications (GAF Master Elite, Owens Corning Preferred, Malarkey certified, etc.) — these matter for warranty support.
- Good reviews and recent local references; check Google, Yelp, BBB.
- Written, itemized estimate and contract (scope, materials, timeline, cleanup).
- Willingness to work with your insurance and meet the adjuster on site.
- Clear warranties (labor and materials) and lien waiver on final payment.

Questions to ask a roofer
- How many Denver hail repairs have you done this year?
- Can you show examples/refs of recent hail jobs nearby?
- Are you licensed/registered where required and insured?
- Which shingle brands do you install and what warranties do they offer?
- Do you subcontract work? If so, who is responsible for permits and cleanup?
- Do you provide a written storm report/roof inspection and photos?

Red flags
- High‑pressure tactics to sign immediately (common with “storm chasers”).
- Only one estimate or refusal to meet the insurance adjuster.
- No proof of insurance or unwillingness to provide certificates.
- Demand for large upfront cash payment (use staged payments tied to milestones).

If you share your ZIP code and whether you’ll be using insurance, I’ll pull up 3–5 well-rated Denver hail‑damage roofers and summarize their reviews, certifications, and typical warranties so you can compare.
